g.text: 12 V ABSENT: optocoupler off; MCU pull-up reads HIGH = drive mode.

g.desc: 12 V ABSENT: optocoupler off; MCU pull-up reads HIGH = drive mode.

g.text: 12 V PRESENT: optocoupler on; input LOW = charge mode.

g.desc: 12 V PRESENT: optocoupler on; input LOW = charge mode.

g.text: MCU, comm and throttle 5 V stay powered in both modes.

g.desc: MCU, comm and throttle 5 V stay powered in both modes.

g.text: J11.1 -> motor board J16.1 -> U4 pin 2 / PC13.

g.desc: J11.1 -> motor board J16.1 -> U4 pin 2 / PC13.

g.text: J11.2 -> motor board ground, e.g. J4.5 or J9.5.

g.desc: J11.2 -> motor board ground, e.g. J4.5 or J9.5.

g.text: Configure PC13 as a digital INPUT WITH PULL-UP to its own 3.3 V.

g.desc: Configure PC13 as a digital INPUT WITH PULL-UP to its own 3.3 V.

g.text: Do not configure push-pull output; no 5 V pull-up is fitted on this board.

g.desc: Do not configure push-pull output; no 5 V pull-up is fitted on this board.

g.text: Firmware must keep gate-driver/PWM outputs disabled from reset,

g.desc: Firmware must keep gate-driver/PWM outputs disabled from reset,

g.text: read mode before arming, and inhibit drive immediately in charge mode.

g.desc: read mode before arming, and inhibit drive immediately in charge mode.

g.text: Re-arm only after 12 V is absent, settling delay and idle throttle.

g.desc: Re-arm only after 12 V is absent, settling delay and idle throttle.

g.text: This signal senses the 12 V command, not relay contact position.

g.desc: This signal senses the 12 V command, not relay contact position.
